official_sources.title: Planning Data documentation and API reference

verified_claims: The entity endpoint supports json, html and geojson response extensions.
Entity records can include dataset, reference, geometry and point fields; geometry and point use WKT.
Coordinate queries require latitude and longitude together.
Coordinate and polygon examples use WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Geometry filters support WKT and explicit spatial-relation parameters.
Supported spatial relations include within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses.
The entity endpoint accepts dataset, entity, reference, curie, field, exclude_field, limit and offset filters.
Large result sets use limit and offset; response links expose next, previous, first and last navigation.
The API has no batch endpoint for portfolio screening and recommends polite rate limiting.
Bulk dataset pages provide stable local-analysis snapshots in CSV, JSON and where applicable GeoJSON and Parquet.
Bulk snapshot provenance must be retained separately from a live API response.
An absence of query results is not proof that no planning constraint exists because coverage varies.
The API is described as beta, so response-contract drift must remain fail-closed.
No Planning documentation readback supplies the three candidates' authoritative HMLR identity or measured elevation.
